data.name: Just Patrol
data.detailed_description:
JustPatrol is a first-person psychological horror simulation game. As a new night security guard, you must guard the empty school alone.

The job is simple. Check the patrol points marked on the map and report any anomalies via radio. Turn on lights if they are off, and check doors if they are open.

But be careful. The familiar corridors might feel strange, or something different from yesterday might be watching you. Is it just a feeling, or is there really something here?

Key Features

  • Realistic Patrol Duty: Experience the tension of patrolling a dark building relying only on a flashlight. Check the map, complete your work log, and act professionally.

  • Changing Environment: The school changes little by little over your 4-day shift. The peace of the first day will not last until the end.

  • Report Anomalies: Lights that won't turn on, objects moving on their own, footsteps... Report all signs of anomalies.

  • Creeping Horror: We aim for psychological horror that tightens with atmosphere and sound rather than jump scares.

Your shift has started. We hope you clock out safely.

data.short_description: "Just patrol. Just report the anomalies." In a dark school, you are the night security guard. Patrol the designated areas every night, turn on lights, and check locked doors. It seems like a simple job, but as the days pass, you'll feel something changing. Can you survive your 4-day shift log?
